description: This file defines the `Reminder_Invitee` class, a PHP class representing invitee records associated with reminders in a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for saving, loading, and deleting invitee data, and manages relationships between reminders and invitees.

classes.name: Reminder_Invitee
classes.description: A class extending Basic, representing invitee entries for reminders, including methods to handle CRUD operations and relationship mappings.

methods.name: saveRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Saves multiple invitees for a specific reminder, handling new and existing invitees and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: loadRemindersInviteesData
methods.description: Loads invitee data related to a specific reminder, with optional duplication handling.

methods.name: getInviteeName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name for an invitee based on their module and ID.

methods.name: deleteRemindersInviteesMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple invitees associated with a reminder, except those explicitly excluded.
